title: MV How to translate and/or change YEP Quest Journal plugin?

posts.author: Xipinjin
posts.body:
Hi everyone, I'm currently working on a videogame project and I'm using the YEP Quest Journal plugin for the players to remember the current and finished quests that you will get during the game.
I correctly managed to install and use the plugin but I have a little problem.
My first language is french and I would like to translate words like "From", "Location" or "Objective" into french (something like "Employeur", "Lieu de Travail" and "Objectifs").
I would also like to get rid of the "Level" and "Reward" text because I don't want to have any difficulty or rewards in the game.
Do you know how I could do this? I'm know almost nothing about JavaScript or coding so a little help would be really appreciated!
Thanks and have a nice day

posts.author: Robro33
posts.body: did you try changing the parameters? the terms "Objective", "Location", etc. are used only in a couple places.

posts.author: Xipinjin
posts.body:
Thanks a lot! You just solved my problem.
I was too shy to modify these parameters haha
Thanks again
